sloka: माता ते पितरम् देवि ततह् केकयमब्रवीत् ।शम्स मे जीव वा मा वा न मामपहसिष्यसि ॥२-३५-२३॥
transliteration: mātā te pitaram devi tatah kekayamabravīt ।śamsa me jīva vā mā vā na māmapahasiṣyasi ॥2-35-23॥

translations.english: Then your mother said to your father, 'Whether you live or die, tell me the cause. You are laughing at me'.
